surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 56 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Muddaththir (The Cloaked One) is the 74th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 56 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا ايها المدثر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O you who covers himself [with a garment]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You, wrapped in your cloak

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Arise and warn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: arise and give warning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your clothing purify
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: cleanse yourself

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And uncleanliness avoid
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: keep away from all filth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not confer favor to acquire more
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do not be overwhelmed and weaken

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But for your Lord be patient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the trumpet is blown
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the Trumpet sounds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the disbelievers - not easy
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will have no ease

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Leave Me with the one I created alone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالࣰ ا مَّمۡدُودࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then gave vast wealth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And children present [with him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and sons by his side

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: making everything easy for him––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he desires that I should add more
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet he still hopes I will give him more

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: I will cover him with arduous torment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he thought and deliberated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He planned and plotted––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: devilishly he plotted

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ferociously he plotted!––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he considered [again]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and looked

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he frowned and scowled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and frowned and scowled

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and turned away and behaved arrogantly

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ يُؤۡثَرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقال ان هذا الا سحر يؤثر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery

ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is not but the word of a human being
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: just the talk of a mortal!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: I will drive him into Saqar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will throw him into the scorching Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is Saqar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It spares nothing and leaves nothing

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Blackening the skins
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it scorches the flesh of humans

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Over it are nineteen [angels]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: there are nineteen in charge of it––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما جعلنا اصحاب النار الا ملائكة ۙ وما جعلنا عدتهم الا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين اوتوا الكتاب ويزداد الذين امنوا ايمانا ۙ ولا يرتاب الذين اوتوا الكتاب والمؤمنون ۙ وليقول الذين في قلوبهم مرض والكافرون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلا ۚ كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء ۚ وما يعلم جنود ربك الا هو ۚ وما هي الا ذكرى للبشر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! By the moon
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yes––by the moon

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the departing night

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the morning when it brightens
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the shining dawn

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is one of the mightiest things

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As a warning to humanity
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a warning to all mortals

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لمن شاء منكم ان يتقدم او يتاخر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but the Companions of the Right will stay

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in Gardens and ask

ayahs.translation_saheeh: About the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: about the guilty

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor did we used to feed the poor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we did not feed the poor

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we denied the Day of Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Until there came to us the certainty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: until the Certain End came upon us.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: like frightened asses

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Fleeing from a lion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: fleeing from a lion

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّنَشَّرَةࣰ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل يريد كل امرئ منهم ان يؤتى صحفا منشرة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but truly this is a reminder

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then whoever wills will remember it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما يذكرون الا ان يشاء الله ۚ هو اهل التقوى واهل المغفرة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness
